name: InfiAgent-DABench
description: InfiAgent-DABench is the first benchmark designed to evaluate LLM-based agents on data analysis tasks, featuring a dataset of 257 data analysis questions derived from 52 CSV files. It includes an agent framework for serving and evaluation, using format-prompting to convert open-ended questions into closed-form formats for automatic evaluation.
reputation: A niche but notable early benchmark for evaluating LLM agents on data analysis tasks, with limited community adoption so far.
notes: Includes a specialized agent DAAgent that outperforms GPT-3.5 by 3.9% on the benchmark.
